question: Should OpenClaw adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` plus `defaultAccount` as the supported public model for multiple Teams bot identities on one gateway?
rationale: This is a new channel capability and configuration contract with compatibility-sensitive state and credential semantics; implementation correctness cannot decide whether this is the desired permanent product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the account model
options.body: Approve the object-based account model, then require focused fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Request a narrower design
options.body: Keep the feature open but ask for a smaller owner-approved API or a staged implementation before accepting the public configuration surface.

options.title: Defer multi-account Teams
options.body: Pause this capability if multiple Teams identities are not currently a supported product priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the account model
recommendation.body: Approve the object-based account model, then require focused fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have carried the replacement chain and are best positioned to answer implementation questions, while final product acceptance remains with an OpenClaw owner.
